record_at_loss.notes: Third champion whose body differs from its parent by one number, and the first crowned on the Metal engine and the hysteresis cadence read. size_span 10.0 compresses the static size-principle gain (mn_gains 'size': 770**(-f) by input-synapse rank) to 10**(-f), leaving the eight 1.0 force overlays and singleton pools unchanged. Lane A's mechanism reading (CD1-QE, seed-level per-MN rates on nc1): under nc1's drive the largest motor neurons in each pool are silent and the small ones fire at 36-78 Hz, so at a 770-fold span the firing cells delivered 1/250 to 1/770 of a large cell's force and the hind levator pool summed to 0.001 activation; at span 10 the same firing pattern delivers usable force. The first-order activation model has no tetanic summation, so the compression stands in for the fused force real muscle holds at those rates (CALIBRATION-LEDGER mn.size_gain_span). Carries nc1's mechanisms unchanged: body_joint_tau_act_ms 6.0 on the six CTr_pitch joints, signs=measured, per-neuron length delays, conductance synapses with shunting, the 19a006_13ba graded set with searched dials. Two nominations were filed; span 30 (10 of 18 qualifying on lane seeds, misses on the floor) was not matched and stands as a lineage candidate. Lane D's qg1 plus abd_gain 0.3 five-seed screen stood 4/5 and put posture variability in band on the standing runs, but cost about one cadence leg; it is a candidate signal, not a champion closure.
